formElement.label: Configuration Name:
formElement.documentation: Select the pre-configured Delinea Secret Server connection.

formElement.label: Secret ID:
formElement.documentation: Numeric ID of the secret in Delinea Secret Server (e.g., 2048 for SSH Keys, 1042 for DB/API credentials). Provide either Secret ID or Secret Path.

formElement.label: Secret Path:
formElement.documentation: Full path or unique name to lookup the secret (e.g., /DevOps/Databases/AppDB). Used if Secret ID is omitted.

formElement.label: Fields to Extract:
formElement.documentation: Comma-separated list of field slugs (e.g., username,password,api_key). Leave blank to extract all fields.

formElement.label: Output Property Sheet:
formElement.documentation: Path to the CDRO property sheet where extracted secrets will be saved.

formElement.label: Export to Pipeline Runtime:
formElement.documentation: Publish all secret values and .pem key to /myPipelineRuntime for cross-stage pipeline access.

formElement.label: Pipeline Property Sheet:
formElement.documentation: Target path on /myPipelineRuntime where secret properties and .pem key will be stored.

formElement.label: Destination File Path:
formElement.documentation: Optional local file path on the CDRO agent to write a secret field (e.g. ~/.ssh/id_rsa, /tmp/cert.pem, or apikey.txt).

formElement.label: File Field Slug:
formElement.documentation: Field slug to write to the Destination File Path (e.g. private-key, certificate-file, apiKey). Auto-detected if omitted.

formElement.label: File Permissions:
formElement.documentation: POSIX permissions for the saved file (e.g., 0600 for SSH keys, 0644 for general files).

formElement.label: Fetch File Attachments:
formElement.documentation: Whether to automatically download binary/text file attachment contents from Delinea.

formElement.label: Create Job Credential:
formElement.documentation: If checked, automatically creates a dynamic runtime CDRO job credential using username and password.

formElement.label: Job Credential Name:
formElement.documentation: Name of the CDRO job credential to create (required if Create Job Credential is checked).

formElement.label: Username Field Slug:
formElement.documentation: Secret field slug mapped to credential username (default: username).

formElement.label: Password Field Slug:
formElement.documentation: Secret field slug mapped to credential password (default: password).

formElement.label: Mask Passwords in Output:
formElement.documentation: Mask sensitive values in CDRO job step logs.
